notes.title: New update v1.5.2
notes.content: Now supporting Steam Deck and Xbox controller. You can set it when starting the game or change it by going to a Save State and choose 'Options'.

tags.feature: - Now supporting Steam Deck and Xbox controller.

notes.title: New update v1.5.1
notes.content: When using a controller, the sword and shield icons in HUD are switching places to make more sense with a controller setup.

tags.feature: When using a controller, the sword and shield icons in HUD are switching places to make more sense with a controller setup.

notes.title: New update v1.5.0
notes.content: Finally added some controller support. The UI will change when you choose for playing with a controller. Current players can change this by going to a Save State and choose 'Options'. There you can change the way you play the game. The support was mainly focused on the Nintendo Switch Pro controller. More options might be added in the future.

tags.feature: - Finally added some controller support.

- Current players can change this by going to a Save State and choose 'Options'.
- There you can change the way you play the game.
- The support was mainly focused on the Nintendo Switch Pro controller.
- More options might be added in the future.

notes.title: New update v1.4.0
notes.content:

- Notifications to show how the controls work

- Small environment update for Seledin Village
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: New update v1.3.0
notes.content:
- You can now immediately get your first shield in the intro dungeon. Making the player strong enough to do the first dungeon before going to the village.*
- The room to get the first sword has been replaced.*
- A puzzle in dungeon 5 has been replaced, focusing more on puzzle instead of battle.
- The intro is now even shorter.
- The game will automatically equip the first few Q-items.
- The sleep animation inside an Inn is now improved.
- There are some text changes and overall improvements. 

* These changes are only for players that start the game in this version.
